decisions.reason: J_LED_CHG is a dedicated charge-status connector and does not change the J_PWR_SIGNAL connector, its pinout, or the interboard signal interface.
The charge-status LED connector and R6 population change do not alter J_BAT, its pin functions, physical pin order, or battery compatibility.
The source changes charge-status indication hardware, not overcharge, overdischarge, thermal sensing, or other battery-protection behavior.
Adding a charge-status LED output does not change any ESP32 clock, sleep, deep-sleep, or wake-source rule.
The dedicated J_LED_CHG connector is not J_PWR_POWER and does not change the interboard power connector type, pin count, or pin-order rule.
The CHGLED circuit and R6 change do not affect the MT3608 boost enable, GPIO control, default state, or sensor-power operating pattern.
Although a connector is added to the power board, the source specifies no change to board dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, connector placement, spacing, or clearance constraints.
R6 is explicitly changed as part of the CHGLED circuit; the source does not change I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, or cable constraints.
The existing requirement already generally targets power-board connector pins, and the source neither changes the marking rule nor specifies a new labeling behavior for J_LED_CHG.
The charge-status circuit change remains within the existing power board and does not alter the three-board architecture or the roles of the main and sensor boards.
The source changes circuit components but does not resume or modify the deferred requirement for JLCPCB assembly part numbers.
The added charge-status connector and resistor changes do not alter the specified four-layer power-board stack.
